project.description_en: At the end of the theme, the child shows a seed planted in a bag or a pot, says what it needs, names three fruits or vegetables and counts to 10 in French.

activities.goal_en: Listen to a story about a seed and say what a plant needs.
activities.prompt_en: Listen to the story of the little seed. What did it need to grow?
steps_en: Show a seed and a small plant.
Tell the story slowly, with gestures for the sun and the rain.
Ask: what did the seed need?
Act the story: the child grows like the seed.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 14 (Storytelling: Short stories), p. 39; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.story_en: A little seed slept under the soil. “Wake up!” said the rain, and gave it water. “Wake up!” said the sun, and gave it warmth. The seed stretched a tiny root down and a little green shoot up. Every day Ngwa watered it. One morning, there was a beautiful yellow flower, and Ngwa danced with joy.

activities.title_en: Fruits and vegetables at the market
activities.goal_en: Read pictures of fruits and vegetables and name them.
activities.prompt_en: Look at the market pictures. What is this fruit? What is this vegetable?
steps_en: Show pictures or real fruits and vegetables.
Name each one together.
Ask the child to find “the banana”, “the tomato”.
Make a picture chart: fruits on one side, vegetables on the other.
observe_en: Shares what they like to eat.
materials_en: pictures or real fruits and vegetables
source_refs: Nursery One, table 17 (Reading: Picture reading), p. 42; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Write the numbers 1, 2 and 3 in the right direction.
activities.prompt_en: Let us write 1: from the top, down. Now 2 and 3.
steps_en: Show each number and count objects for it.
Trace the number in the air.
Trace it in sand or on a slate.
Write it on paper, following the model.
observe_en: Starts each number at the top.
Links the number to the objects.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 18 (Writing: Letters and numbers), p. 43; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.prompt_en: In French: un, deux, trois, quatre, cinq, six, sept, huit, neuf, dix!
steps_en: Count 10 seeds in English.
Count them again in French, slowly.
The child repeats each number.
Play: show fingers, the child says the number in French.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 19 (French: Compter), p. 44; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Sort fruits by colour and by size and count each group.
activities.prompt_en: Put the yellow fruits together and the green fruits together. Which group has more?
steps_en: Put fruits on the table.
Sort by colour together.
Count each group.
Now sort the same fruits by size.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 20 (Mathematics: Classifying elements), p. 45; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.title_en: Planting a seed in a bag
activities.goal_en: Plant a seed, water it and watch it grow.
activities.prompt_en: Let us plant a maize seed in this bag of soil and give it water.
steps_en: Fill a planting bag with soil.
Make a small hole with a finger.
Put the seed in and cover it with soil.
Water a little and put the bag in the light; water every day.
observe_en: Puts the seed in the hole and covers it.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 23 (Agriculture: Gardening), p. 49; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Count seeds up to 10 and make groups.
activities.prompt_en: How many beans are in my hand? Let us count them on the table.
steps_en: Put 6 to 10 beans on the table.
Count them, moving each bean aside.
Make groups of 2.
Count the groups.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 20 (Mathematics: Counting), p. 45; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

interactive.prompt_en: How many beans can you see?
interactive.explanation_en: Touch each bean while you count: there are 8 beans.

activities.goal_en: Recognise sunny and rainy weather and play at the right time and place.
activities.prompt_en: Look at the sky. Is it sunny or rainy? Can we play outside?
steps_en: Look at the sky with the child.
Show weather pictures: sun, clouds, rain.
Choose the picture for today.
Talk: when it rains, we play inside; when it is very hot, we play in the shade.
observe_en: Names the weather of the day.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 26 (Environmental Education: Climate change), p. 52; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Know that fruits and vegetables help us stay healthy.
activities.prompt_en: Fruits and vegetables help our body to grow strong. Which one will you eat today?
steps_en: Show a plate with rice and a plate with rice and vegetables.
Ask: which plate is better for the body?
Wash a fruit together before eating.
Share the fruit.
observe_en: Names a fruit they eat at home.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 28 (Health Education and Nutrition: Good health habits), p. 54; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Volunteer to care for the school garden with others.
activities.prompt_en: Who wants to help water the school flowers today? Helpers make our school beautiful.
steps_en: Show the school garden or flower pots.
Ask for volunteers.
Water the plants together and remove some dry leaves.
Thank the helpers.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 24 (Citizenship: Self-introduction), p. 50; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Colour a flower with the three primary colours.
activities.prompt_en: Colour the petals red and yellow and the sky blue.
steps_en: Show the three primary colours: red, blue, yellow.
Draw a flower with a circle and petals.
Colour the petals red or yellow.
Colour the sky blue.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 30 (Drawing and Colouring: Colours), p. 56; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

editorial.notes: Activity written for Klassia from the Nursery One contents of the English-subsystem nursery curriculum; original texts. To be reviewed by a Nursery One teacher of the English subsystem.

activities.goal_en: Carry water carefully in a team race.
activities.prompt_en: Carry the cup of water to the plant without spilling, then come back. Which team waters all its plants?
steps_en: Make two teams with a cup each.
Each child carries water to a plant and pours it.
Walk carefully, do not run with water.
Count the watered plants.
source_refs: Nursery One, table 32 (Physical Education and Sports: Team sports), p. 58; theme 5: Plants (table 13, p. 37)

scale.description: Succeeds mostly with a model or help.
Sometimes succeeds alone, sometimes with a reminder.
Succeeds on their own in a familiar situation.

indicators: Names three fruits and three vegetables.
Sorts fruits by colour or size.
Plants a seed and waters it.
Writes the numbers 1, 2 and 3 with help.
Counts to 10 in French with help.
Colours a flower with primary colours.

sources: Cameroon Nursery School Curriculum, English Subsystem, MINEDUB, 2018: table 13 (integrated learning themes), p. 37; Nursery One tables, cited and not reproduced.
